workouts.title: Snatch
workouts.description:
Snatch
3x3 @ 60-70% // RPE 6
Rest 2-3 Minutes Between Sets.
NOTES:
- Focus on your technique even though the weight is light this week!

workouts.title: Snatch Pull
workouts.description:
Snatch Pull
3x3 @95-100%  RPE 8
Rest 1:30 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- Aim to have a :03 lowering on each rep.

workouts.title: Back Squat
workouts.description:
Back Squat
3x3 @ 60-70% // RPE 6
Rest 2-3 Minutes Between Sets.

NOTES:
- If you have been on the program for the last few weeks, today should be a welcome deload! Focus on making each rep technically perfect and stick to the percentages/RPE.
- If you have not been on the program, today will be light, and we will get into some heavier reps next week.

workouts.title: METCON
workouts.description:
6 x 3 minutes on, 1 min off
Amrap 1:
- 50' Burpee Broad Jump
- 20 Kettlebell Swings @ 53/35 lbs
- Max Cal Machine in remaining time

Amrap 2
- 20/17 Cal Machine
- 20 Alt Hang DB Snatches
- Max distance burpee broad jumps

workouts.title: EXTRA / ACCESSORY
workouts.description:
2 Sets:
15/15 Single Leg Glute Bridge *
20 Goblet Lunge @ 35/25lbs
Rest 1:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
* Do these glut bridges unweighted with a one-second pause at the top of each rep. Focus on squeezing your glutes as hard as possible during the one-second pause.
- This piece should not be very difficult; it is intended to keep the lower body firing during deload week.

workouts.title: Push Press
workouts.description:
Push Press
3x3 @ 60-70 %  RPE 6
Rest 1-2 Minutes Between Sets.

NOTES:
- These should feel easy!
- Always reset in the front rack; do not go with touch-and-go reps at the shoulder

workouts.title: Strict Press
workouts.description:
Strict Press
3x10 @ 40-50 %
Rest 1 Minute Between Sets.

NOTES:
- Like the push press, these should feel easy, but you will get a pump.
- Perform each rep with control, no bouncing off the chest.

workouts.title: METCON
workouts.description:
Amrap 12 minutes
12 Box Jumps @ 24/20",  Step down
12 T2B
12 Forward Lunges @ 95/65 lbs

workouts.title: CARDIO INTERVALS.
workouts.description:
CARDIO INTERVALS.
Every 2:00 x 20:00... (10 Sets)
1: 1:15 Max Cal Fan Bike
2: 1:15 Max Cal Row

NOTES:
- With only :45 of rest on each set, choose your pace carefully. This whole piece should feel like an RPE 8.
- The first 4-5 sets should feel well under your threshold pace.

workouts.title: EXTRA / ACCESSORY
workouts.description:
Single Arm Dumbbell Upright Row
3x15/15
Rest 1:00

NOTES
- Use a light weight that allows you to focus on moving the weight with your lats.

Barbell Curl
2x25
Rest 1:00 Between Sets.

workouts.title: Clean & Jerk
workouts.description:
Clean & Jerk
3x(3+1) @ 65-75 %
Rest 2 Minutes Between Sets.

NOTES:
- Aim to make each rep technically perfect.
- Take your time between reps and reset for each clean.

workouts.title: Clean Pull
workouts.description:
Clean Pull
3x3 @ 90-100% RPE 8
Rest 1:30 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- Aim to have a :03 lowering on each rep.
No glute ham raise or sumo deadlift this week.

workouts.title: Dumbbell Incline Bench
workouts.description:
Dumbbell Incline Bench
3 Sets:
:45 Max Reps Bench ** // RPE 7-8
Rest 1:30 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- We are adding :05 this week for the last time.
- Perform these with a @ 2020 tempo (i.e. :02 down, no pause at the bottom, :02 up, no pause at the top).
- Don't game the :45, perform controlled reps for the forty-five seconds.
- Use a load that feels like an RPE 7 at the start of
these sets.

workouts.title: Strict Pull-Up
workouts.description:
Strict Pull-Up

OPTION A:

Banded Strict Pull-Up
3x20, Unbroken
NOTES:
- This option is for those who either have strict pull-ups but are not ready to load them, or for people who do not have strict pull-ups and will need to use a band.
- Use as little band tension as possible. If 20 reps is too easy, you may take each set to failure.
----

OPTION B:

Weighted Strict Pull-Up
6x4 @ 5RM Weight.
Rest 1:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- Max sure that you perform each rep as explosively as possible.
- If you did not do the 5RM, aim for a load that feels like an RPE 8-9.

workouts.description:

Deadlifts @ 225/155 lbs

Ring Dips

workouts.title: Banded Tricep Pushdown
workouts.description:
Banded Tricep Pushdown
- Accumulate 100 reps in as few sets as possible.

NOTES:
- Perform every rep with intention and control.

workouts.title: Fan Bike Intervals
workouts.description:
Fan Bike Intervals.

4 Sets:
2:00 On...
16/12 Cal @ Hard Pace
Hold 80% of HARD Pace For Remaining Time.
Rest 1:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- The "hard pace" should be 85% of what would be a true sprint.
FAN BIKE

workouts.title: Power Snatch
workouts.description:
Power Snatch
5x3 @ 65-70%
Rest 1:30 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- These are not meant to be touch-and-go sets.

workouts.title: Front Squat
workouts.description:
Front Squat
3x3 @75%
Rest 1-2 Minutes Between Sets.
NOTES:
- Focus on perfect positions today, specifically keeping your torso upright with your hips under you.

workouts.title: Conditioning
workouts.description:
EMOM 28
1: 15/12 Cal Row
2: 14/11 Cal Ski
3: 14/11 Cal Fan Bike
4: 15 Wall Ball @ 20/14lbs
NOTES:
- The row, ski, and fan bike should be completed in :45 or less, scale accordingly.
- Aim to go unbroken on the wall balls.

workouts.title: EXTRA / ACCESSORY
workouts.description:
A) D-Ball / Sandbag Bear Hug Hold or Carry 3x100ft or :30
Rest 1:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- Use the heaviest d-ball / sandbag that you can maintain for unbroken sets.

B) Dumbbell Hammer Curl
2x25
Rest :30 Between Sets.
